selection_basis.method: Manual selection from spatial clusters in 1-arc-minute Flood pixel counts, considering valid classified pixel support. Reported impact locations were not used as a selection criterion.
selection_basis.flood_pixel_count: Reconstructed per cell as round(Flood Fraction [%] * valid class-0-to-4 pixel count / 100); sum matches the source-derived total.
selection_basis.aoi_pixel_center_rule: west <= longitude < east and south <= latitude < north
selection_basis.area_method: Spherical area of the union of 1-arc-minute cells inside the non-overlapping, minute-aligned rectangles; Earth radius 6371008.8 m.

diagnostics.pixel_equivalent_method: Selected spherical area divided by 400 m2 per 20 m pixel; this is an area-based estimate, not a projected-grid cut or aligned-pixel count.
diagnostics.next_step_note: Transform each selected WGS84 rectangle to the source Equi7 CRS and align the final cuts to the native 20 m pixel grid. No 20 m transform or cut was performed here.

focus_areas.name: Western lower cluster
focus_areas.reason: Contains the strongest compact western-southwestern cluster, with high Flood pixel count and substantial valid support.

focus_areas.name: South-central cluster
focus_areas.reason: Retains several adjacent high-count clusters in the southern-central part of the analysis domain in one compact rectangle.

focus_areas.name: Eastern lower cluster
focus_areas.reason: Covers a separate eastward concentration of Flood pixels while avoiding the much larger surrounding low-density area.

focus_areas.name: Central cluster group
focus_areas.reason: Combines two nearby moderate-to-high count clusters to avoid separate overlapping selection boxes.

focus_areas.name: North-central cluster
focus_areas.reason: Includes two adjacent northern-central clusters with consistent valid support and a combined material Flood count.

focus_areas.name: East-central cluster
focus_areas.reason: Preserves a distinct Flood cluster with a material count and broad source-pixel support.

focus_areas.name: Western northern corridor
focus_areas.reason: Captures the largest connected high-count cluster, with substantial valid observation support.

focus_areas.name: Eastern northern corridor
focus_areas.reason: Retains a separate eastern northern cluster rather than extending F07 across a broad low-density gap.
